events.title: FDA sets purity specifications for vitamin D2 inactive bakers yeast

verification.notes: PDF text layer of the govinfo Federal Register file, page 60800, paragraphs (c)(6) through (c)(9).

events.summary: The 25 September 2026 final order adds 21 CFR 172.383. Vitamin D2 inactive bakers yeast must contain not more than 0.5 mg/kg lead, 0.3 mg/kg arsenic, 0.5 mg/kg cadmium, and 0.1 mg/kg mercury. The order is effective 25 September 2026. Arsenic and mercury are unspecified and are recorded as totals. The figures are additive specifications, not finished-food maximum levels.
